resolution.note: lane budget counts only directories holding .git; regression test in test/cli/lane.test.ts

title: Lane budget counts only real git worktrees
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-15, S26 lane refused by `krn lane start` (exit 64, 9 live > 8).
Why: the lane budget in src/cli/lane.ts counts every directory under .krn/worktrees, so a test fixture (test/tool-scope.test.ts writes .krn/worktrees/scope-probe-<pid>) and stale dirs block real lanes.
Outcome: the budget counts only registered git worktrees (git worktree list) under .krn/worktrees; tool-scope fixture still cleans up.
Proof: regression test in test/cli: a plain directory under .krn/worktrees does not count toward KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE.
